scope: Two complete Qwen3-8B TP2-equation forwards from pinned original safetensors, original embedding rows and internally computed per-layer causal KV history.

arithmetic.projection: Independent chunked dense FP64 BF16-product row sum; QKV/gate/up narrow FP64 -> FP32 -> BF16 RNE. FP64 sums are retained. No GPU lane-tree replay.
arithmetic.norm: Independent FP64 sum of squares and inverse sqrt using the exact FP32 epsilon bit pattern; BF16 normalized value then BF16 weight product. Not source-exact FP32 norm intermediates.
arithmetic.rope: Cosine/sine recomputed independently from original position and theta1000000, narrowed to FP32; split-half separate FP32 multiplications and add/subtract before BF16 RNE.
arithmetic.attention: Unpaged independent FP64 two-pass causal softmax, source FP32 scale1/sqrt128, GQA head/4; FP64 output -> FP32 -> BF16 RNE. No OCML or online-wave recurrence replay.
arithmetic.swiglu: Frozen P218 independent FP64 stable sigmoid, SiLU times up, direct BF16 RNE. Not an OCML exact-bit claim.
arithmetic.partial: Each rank's original-NxK O/down independent FP64 dot narrows once to FP32 before ordered TP2 residual.
arithmetic.residual: Frozen P216 integer-bit oracle computes RNE_F32(p0+p1), RNE_F32(sum+BF16_original), then one BF16 RNE. No approximate FP64-add shortcut.
arithmetic.tail: Independent FP64 dual-boundary final norm and original-NxK FP64 language-model head -> FP32 -> BF16 RNE, then first-index maximum. Not a bit replica of retained sequential-FP32 final norm or MFMA head.

input_modes.teacher_forced: Exactly two supplied token IDs; retained token provenance is a pinned caller input, not tokenizer execution by this script.
input_modes.autoregressive: Exactly one supplied initial token; the CPU reference consumes its own first checked argmax as token1. If GPU argmax0 differs, second-forward tensors follow different input trajectories and must not be reported as same-input mismatches.

source_custody: Explicit pinned input roster, five original safetensors, exact config/index, source authentication and token provenance receipts. Receipt bytes are retained; this diagnostic does not upgrade them to compiler or native execution authority.
